Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the question and incorrectly replaced the well-known “Ogallala Aquifer” (explicitly described in authoritative sources as a shallow water-table aquifer named for Ogallala, the county seat) with the North Platte River alluvial aquifer. This error stemmed from conflating total well depth with depth-to-water (water-table depth) and over-weighting local NWIS well completion depths to argue Ogallala is “deep,” contrary to the definition and cited sources. The Planner ignored earlier authoritative confirmations (Wikipedia/USGS) and shifted conclusions without proper evidence, leading to an incorrect final answer.
